blocks.text: Verse 6 records Aaron's death at Moserah during Israel's wilderness journey, marking a significant transition in religious leadership. Aaron belonged to a social world of kinship obligations and household structures essential to Israel's covenant community. More broadly, Aaron exemplified the Exodus and wilderness world where deliverance and covenant define the people of God. His son Eleazar's assumption of the priestly office demonstrates the continuity of institutional leadership within Israel's covenant structures during this formative period.
